Title: Strategic Data Analyst - Global Business Solutions - San Jose

We are looking for a Client Solutions Strategic Data Analyst to join our Client Solutions Team for the North America region. This role will play a key part in developing strategic, customized solutions that connect TikTok’s advertising products with clients’ business objectives.

The Strategic Data Analyst works closely with Sales, Product, Measurement, and Operations teams to design data-driven strategies and tailored solutions for complex business challenges. Title: Business Analyst, Operations Analytics
Description:
About the job

Our mission: eliminating every barrier to mental health.

Spring Health is a global mental health company on a mission to eliminate every barrier to mental health. We're building a world where getting support is simple, personal, and built around the person, so care can continue through every job, move, health plan, and life stage.

Our AI-native platform helps us deliver personalized support across self-guided tools, coaching, therapy, medication management, and specialty care. With outcomes independently validated by JAMA Network Open and the Validation Institute, Spring Health reaches more than 170 million people worldwide through leading employers, health plans, and partners.

As an AI-native company, we believe technology should expand the reach, quality, and humanity of care. Every Spring Health team member is expected to use AI tools thoughtfully, apply human judgment to AI outputs, and keep building AI fluency in ways that support their role and our mission.

Reporting to the Director of Operations Analytics & Workforce Optimization, the Business Analyst, Operations Analytics will drive the strategic analytics work for cross-cutting, operations-wide priorities—some of the most critical initiatives in the department. This role sits on the Operations Analytics team within Operations Intelligence and will serve as a high-leverage analytics partner to Operations leadership, helping define what “good” looks like, how we measure it, and how we improve it. This is a full time, fully-remote position, though the ability to be onsite in our NYC office once a week is preferred.

What You’ll Do

This role will have two primary categories of work:

Strategic Analytics For Ops-wide Initiatives


Provide the strategic analytics horsepower for major, cross-functional Operations initiatives (e.g., AI transformation efforts) by framing ambiguous problems, identifying decision-critical metrics, and driving analyses that directly shape strategy and execution.
Translate complex analytics into clear, actionable recommendations for Operations leadership, leveraging AI functionality wherever possible to reduce time-to-insight and increase actionability. 
Build decision-ready narratives for exec audiences: clear problem statements, crisp insights, quantified tradeoffs, and recommended actions. 
Partner cross-functionally (Operations leaders, BI, Product, and other stakeholders) to ensure analytics work is connected to real operational levers and adopted in day-to-day decision-making.



Ops-wide analytics + performance measurement foundation 


Own the creation of core data and reporting groundwork that ensures Operations understands what should be measured, how it’s measured, and how we’re performing. 
Deliver foundational assets such as:
An Operations-wide metrics dictionary (definitions, logic, ownership, refresh cadence, caveats).
Recurring Operations performance packages that surface the most critical business metrics and trends. 
Metric trees that enable faster, more systematic root-cause analysis when performance shifts. 
Partner closely with leaders across each Operations department and BI partners to align on metric definitions, ensure data quality, and maintain scalable reporting.

What Success Looks Like


Clarity and alignment: Operations leadership has shared definitions for key metrics and trusts the measurement system (fewer “metric debates,” more decision velocity).
Adoption: Operations leaders consistently use the reporting foundation and metric trees in business reviews and in-week decision-making. 
Automation leverage: Reduction in manual recurring reporting hours for priority metrics as reporting becomes more durable and self-serve. 
Time-to-insight: Reduced cycle time from “question raised” → “decision-ready output,” particularly for exec-facing requests. 
Impact on outcomes: Measurable lift in priority Operations KPIs attributable to initiatives this role supports (improved SLA, quality, efficiency, satisfaction, cost outcomes, etc., depending on initiative). 
Internal partner satisfaction: Ops leaders view you as a trusted strategic partner, not just an analytics provider.



What You’ll Bring


Bachelor’s degree in Business, Economics, Engineering, or a similar analytical field; Master’s degree preferred. 
2-4+ years experience in business strategy/analytics or a related role (e.g., consulting, tech, finance), with a track record of driving analytics work that shapes leadership decisions. 
Strong command of data and visualization tools (e.g., SQL, Looker, Hex), and experience building scalable reporting or analytical frameworks. 
Demonstrated ability to partner with senior stakeholders, drive alignment across teams, and move ambiguous workstreams from problem → insight → action. 
Excellent communication and storytelling skills; can synthesize complex analysis into crisp, executive-ready narratives. 
A builder’s mindset: comfortable establishing frameworks, processes, and standards in a scaling environment.

Title: Strategy Analyst
Description:
About the job

About Us

Bambee is an HR tech company providing HR services to small and medium-sized businesses. We're committed to delivering high-quality HR solutions and exceptional customer service. We give small business owners a Dedicated HR Manager plus software for policies, handbooks, terminations, performance management, and compliance.

You'll work directly with the CEO and senior leadership on high-stakes strategic decisions — translating company strategy into materials for investors, partners, and other external stakeholders.




What you'll do:

Partner with the CEO and senior leadership to translate company strategy into external-facing materials
Develop narratives that position Bambee's business model, market opportunity, and competitive advantage to external audiences
Build management presentations that communicate strategy, performance, and vision to investors and other stakeholders
Support high-stakes external communications and materials organization
Coordinate press positioning and external communications strategy
Support continuity planning and stakeholder communications during major company initiatives




What we're looking for:

Analytical thinking

You model before you decide. You can hold multiple variables at once and see how they interact.
You're comfortable in SQL, Sheets, and analytics tools. You can pull your own data and validate other people's claims.
You know the difference between correlation and causation, between a vanity metric and a metric that actually predicts behavior.

Writing and narrative

You write sharp, compelling narratives — management presentations, investor materials, or other high-stakes documents. You know how to tell a story that lands.
You can take complex data and translate it into clear, persuasive positioning for external audiences.
You've worked with investors, bankers, or board members. You understand how they think and what they need to hear.

Operator mindset

You've worked on cross-functional teams and shipped something. You understand what execution costs. You don't confuse ambition with strategy.
You ask "Is this the bottleneck?" and "What do we need to unblock this?" You're equally comfortable in a whiteboard session and in the weeds of a quarterly plan.
You push back on bad logic. You're direct about it, but you're kind.

Title: Business Analyst
Description:
About the job

1161915_RR00119549 Job ID: 1161915_RR00119549

NYU Langone Health is a fully integrated health system that consistently achieves the best patient outcomes through a rigorous focus on quality that has resulted in some of the lowest mortality rates in the nation. Vizient Inc. has ranked NYU Langone the No. 1 comprehensive academic medical center in the country for three years in a row, and U.S. News & World Report recently placed nine of its clinical specialties among the top five in the nation. NYU Langone offers a comprehensive range of medical services with one high standard of care across 6 inpatient locations, its Perlmutter Cancer Center, and over 320 outpatient locations in the New York area and Florida. With $14.2 billion in revenue this year, the system also includes two tuition-free medical schools, in Manhattan and on Long Island, and a vast research enterprise with over $1 billion in active awards from the National Institutes of Health.

For more information, go to NYU Langone Health, and interact with us on LinkedIn, Glassdoor, Indeed, Facebook, Twitter, YouTube and Instagram.

Position Summary

We have an exciting opportunity to join our team as a Business Analyst.

In this role, the successful candidate as the Business Analyst will collaborate with Payroll, MCIT, and Human Resources teams to ensure that UKG Pro and Finance Salesforce technology enhancements and upgrades are optimized to meet the needs of all employees across the organization. The Business Analyst develops and administers various training programs to promote the best practices and compliance with institutional policies as it relates to the enterprise timekeeping application, UKG Pro. Additionally, the Business Analyst supports the documentation, testing and training of Finance Salesforce enhancements for the UKG Training and Support Helpdesk and Finance Helpdesk.

The Business Analyst will identify opportunities to improve existing policies and procedures, and business processes. Assists with administration of and participates in continuous improvement activities. Assists with developing and executing test scripts. Analyze the end-user impact of all change requests or enhancements. Identify opportunities across NYU Langone Healths business and departments and implement process or procedural improvements to create efficiency and high end-user satisfaction.

Job Responsibilities

Data Analysis


Conduct data analyses using UKG Pro, Finance Salesforce, PeopleSoft, Tableau, Excel, and other available reporting tools to identify trends, recurring issues, process gaps, system compliance concerns, and opportunities for improvement. Analysis may include timekeeping and payroll-related data, system ticket trends, enhancement requests, testing results, training participation, end-user adoption, productivity metrics, and department-level adherence to Finance timekeeping policies and procedures.
Monitor UKG system compliance in relation to Finance timekeeping policies and procedures, including review of timekeeping activity, recurring exceptions, punch edits, manager or timekeeper actions, and other system usage trends that may indicate training needs, process gaps, or non-compliance with established standards.
Provide recommendations based on data findings to support process improvement, identify training needs, improve end-user support, reduce recurring system or process issues, strengthen compliance with Finance timekeeping policies and procedures, and inform leadership decision-making.
Develop, maintain, and analyze operational reports and dashboards related to UKG Pro and Finance Salesforce support activities, including ticket volume, issue trends, project status, testing outcomes, training completion, communication/adoption metrics, and department-level process compliance.
Prepare reporting and analytics for Finance leadership, Payroll, HR, MCIT, and project stakeholders to monitor progress, identify risks, prioritize enhancements, evaluate process effectiveness, assess adherence to Finance timekeeping standards, and support business decisions.


Project Management


Manage multiple system, process improvement, training, testing, reporting, compliance monitoring, and change management initiatives related to UKG Pro and Finance Salesforce.
Support projects related to system enhancements, defect resolution, upgrade readiness, user acceptance testing, policy and procedure updates, training development, communication planning, reporting improvements, end-user support initiatives, and compliance with Finance timekeeping policies and procedures.
Track project tasks, document open items, coordinate with Payroll, HR, MCIT, Finance leadership, and operational stakeholders, and provide timely updates on project progress.
Facilitate status meetings, monitor timelines and deliverables, escalate risks or barriers, and ensure project documentation is complete and accurate.
Document defects, enhancements, requests, compliance concerns, and process improvement opportunities for UKG Pro and Finance Salesforce, including business requirements, testing outcomes, end-user impact, policy/procedure considerations, and recommended next steps.


Change management-


Create and deliver engaging PowerPoint presentations for leadership, effectively communicating key insights, project updates, and strategic recommendations.
Assist in developing and executing financial system test scripts for UKG Pro and Finance-Salesforce
Collaborate with Payroll and IT teams to document and evaluate test results.
Analyze the end-user impact of all change requests or enhancements.
Develop, review, document, and update policies and procedures related to financial activities.
Identify training and development needs through job analysis, research, and consultation with finance management and end users.
Work with teams to produce appropriate and effective training programs for all relevant parties in the division.
Engage and document thoroughly and accurately in-bound correspondence in Salesforce.
Assist Senior Business Analyst with creating and distributing end-user communications related to UKG Pro and Finance-Salesforce.
Administer and assist with training initiatives.


Content Creation


Design, develop, and modify training programs, including video courses.
Amend and revise programs as necessary to adapt to changes in the work environment.
Create and compile training materials and manuals.


Perform all other duties or special projects as assigned.

Additional Position Specific Responsibilities

Ensure end-user service both internally and externally. Communicate clearly and concisely with end users promptly. Organize tasks to assign appropriate resources and provide information. Demonstrate initiative to improve services and processes to end users. Demonstrate creative thinking for developing solutions. Manage

multiple tasks and projects. Respect and maintain the confidentiality of all financial information within NYULH. Demonstrate trustworthiness and integrity both to staff and end users. Facilitate a team atmosphere within Finance and respective departments. Cooperate and communicate effectively and harmoniously with administration, peers, general staff, and other NYULH personnel, both courteously and professionally.

Minimum Qualifications

To qualify you must have a Bachelors degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics or Business Administration or Management. Education experience with respect to computer applications and or computer science is a plus, but not required.

A minimum of 2 years of work experience in business process analysis, financial or data analysis or related tasks. The candidate must have analytical and computer skills to support the analysis, documentation and recommendations for improvements of processes across the finance enterprise. The Business Analyst should have solid communication skills that enable the individual to perform interviews with individuals, gather and interpret information as well as convey messages and findings concisely to relevant parties throughout the organization. The individual must be detail oriented and able to work independently and within a team on multiple projects simultaneously. Other minimum qualifications include intermediate working knowledge of Microsoft Office, with a strong emphasis on Excel, Word and Visio. Experience with PeopleSoft Query and Alteryx/Tableau is desired, but not required.

Preferred Qualifications

Familiarity with UKG Pro Workforce Management, Salesforce, Tableau, PeopleSoft, and Learning Management Systems (LMS).

Required Skills: Advanced Excel skills, Experience in content creation, Proficiency in Camtasia, Audiate, Articulate 360, or equivalent software

Qualified candidates must be able to effectively communicate with all levels of the organization.

Title: Junior Business Analyst
Description:
About the job





Business Analyst / Business Development Associate 



A leading trading firm is seeking a Business Analyst to join its team. This role requires strong analytical, research, presentation, and interpersonal skills. The position combines oversight of current business operations with the exploration of new growth opportunities. We are looking for a motivated, intellectually curious individual who is eager to learn, take initiative, and assume ownership of projects. A high level of attention to detail and accuracy is essential.



Key Responsibilities



As a Business Development Associate, you will play a critical role in supporting and managing day-to-day business operations. This includes collaborating closely with the accounting team to reconcile daily transactions, as well as working with brokers and exchanges to investigate and resolve discrepancies. A successful candidate will also identify opportunities to improve these workflows through automation, increasing efficiency and scalability as the business grows.

In addition, the role involves analyzing business performance, identifying new strategic opportunities, and building relationships with industry partners such as exchanges, vendors, and other firms. Your analysis will directly support leadership in making informed strategic decisions and contribute to the company's long-term growth. The position also requires representing the firm professionally in external interactions, making strong communication and relationship-building skills essential.



Desired Skills & Qualifications


Bachelor's degree required, preferably in a quantitative or analytical field
Strong problem-solving, analytical, and communication skills
Advanced proficiency in Excel and similar analytical tools
Demonstrated interest in researching new opportunities and building business relationships
Flexibility to work across global markets and time zones
Prior experience in, or a strong interest in, finance and trading
